messages:
maya: Heads-up on nova-9b bring-up. Ran a quick quant sweep and a lightweight slice pass. Dropping the compact scorecard here.
ryan: sweet 91s this on canonical eval only or include product slices?
maya: canonical + a few product slices (legal, longform QA, short chat). Table: ```
NOVA-9B QUANT SWEEP (summary)
- float16 (baseline): p95=225ms, quality=100.0 (ref), avg tokens/req=430
- int8: p95=195ms (-13%), quality=99.5 (-0.5), cost ~0.68x baseline
- int4: p95=165ms (-27%), quality=97.7 (-2.3), notable diffs on legal slices
- hybrid (int4 for short prefix + int8 for long): p95=170ms, quality=99.0 (-1.0), cost ~0.55x
```
anika: how are you estimating cost multipliers?
maya: using our GPU-token proxy: float16 = $2.5 /1k tokens. int8 ~= $1.7 (68%), int4 ~= $1.4 (56%). Multiply by avg tokens -> $/req.
lina: product ask: GTN wants default that keeps user-visible quality within 1% of baseline. With that constraint, what's your rec?
manika: one quick note: int4 spikes hallucinations on legal/contract prompts in our trust slice. FPR rises.
maya: yep. int4 fails 3 legal prompts consistently (hallucinated statute names). Not acceptable for legal flows.
ryan: infra perspective: int4 reduces KV cache size, which increases cache churn for multi-turns. Tail latency shows more variance (p99 bump).
anika: for GTN defaults: propose int8 default + hybrid routing for latency-critical non-sensitive routes. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 48h.
lina: rollout gates?
maya: suggested gates: overall eval delta_quality >1.0% OR any slice delta >2.5% OR user-feedback complaints >50% vs baseline.
ryan: infra gates: latency p95 increase >15% or error rate >0.5% absolute -> automatic rollback.
devops-bot: Canary deployment ready to schedule. Reply with "approve" to queue. :robot_face:
anika: Also recommend collecting client-side latencies and per-request token counts in A/B to compute real-world cost reduction.
lina: Sales wants a short unit-econ figure: per-1M token savings and monthly impact for a 100M tokens workload.
maya: quick calc: baseline 1M tokens = $2,500. int8 = $1,700 (save $800 /1M). int4 = $1,400 (save $1,100 /1M). Hybrid effective ~ $1,375 depending on split. At 100M tokens -> int8 saves ~$80k/mo, int4 ~$110k/mo.
manika: but add caveat: int4 risk on legal slices + slightly higher tail which can affect p99 SLAs.
anika: ops rec: monitor KV cache miss rate, p95/p99 histograms, and a slice-level quality dashboard during canary.
ryan: I'll add infra dashboards and set OOM/oom-killer alerts lower threshold for quant canary.
lina: can someone draft the 3-line rec for GTN? need by EOD.
maya: draft: "Recommend GTN default to int8 quant (approx -0.5% quality, ~32% token-cost reduction). Enable hybrid routing for latency-sensitive, non-sensitive flows. Run 48h 5% canary with eval and user-feedback gates; block if any slice regresses >2.5% or latency/error triggers hit."
manika: +routing rule: mark legal slice as blocked for int4/hybrid short path.
devops-bot: Canary scheduled by ryan at 1742110800. Monitor channel #eng-oncall.
anika: can you paste the command to reproduce the sweep so solutions can run it?
maya: paste: ```bash
./run_quant_sweep --model nova-9b \ 
  --modes float16,int8,int4 \ 
  --slices canonical,legal,longform,chat-short \ 
  --out /artifacts/nova-quant-1742109999
```
ryan: I'll hook deploy-bot into the canary and set the rollback webhooks.
lina: thanks all. Action items: 1) canary + dashboards (ryan) 2) one-pager & sales figures (anika) 3) artifacts + failure examples (maya) 4) block legal->int4 routing (manika).
maya: I'll upload two failure examples (legal hallucination pairs) to the artifact and flag them in the scorecard.
anika: tagging this for product signoff. Approve?
lina: approve.
manika: approve.
drydevops-bot: queued deploy. Reminder: keep an eye on #eng-oncall and /alerts.
ryan: starting dashboard wiring now.
maya: will follow up with short eval snapshots after the run.
anika: thanks team :thumbsup:
